main_result.statement: For the fixed-hub rank-one leaf packet A_LL=D+lambda vv^T and c=A[L,h]=mu v+theta z with v,z orthonormal, if a literal triangle S has Pluecker mass t=det(sum_{i in S}u_i u_i^T) and max triangle row leverage at most eta<t, then the cyclic physical 2x2 crossing determinants obey sum_i |det C_i|^2 >= lambda^2 theta^2 t(t-eta), hence one has |det C_i| >= |lambda theta| sqrt(t(t-eta)/3).
main_result.scope: Original independent coordinates; arbitrary physical diagonal D and hub scalar; structural crossing certificate only, not a standalone Linfinity density theorem.
